title: Proper compact-support and tensor comparisons identify etale and pro-etale projection maps
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Use the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $C_W=\nu_W^*$ for the derived comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $D^b_{ctf}$ mean bounded constructible complexes whose derived tensor with every degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology in one fixed finite interval [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

For the identity-open compactification put $F_e=Ri_{e,*}$, $F_p=Ri_{p,*}$, $G_e=i^\times$ and $G_p=C_ZG_eR\nu_{T,*}$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Let $b_B:C_TF_eB\xrightarrow{\sim}F_pC_ZB$ be the canonical direct-image mate of the ordinary pullback comparison, normalized to commute with the ordinary pullback/direct-image counits. Put $\eta_B=b_B^{-1}$. Use the exceptional adjunction on bounded-below etale-origin objects transported by the site-comparison unit, and write $\mu^e,\mu^p$ for its counits. Then for bounded constructible $N$ with $G_eN$ bounded constructible, under $G_pC_TN\cong C_ZG_eN$,
$$\mu^p_{C_TN}=C_T(\mu^e_N)\circ\eta_{G_eN}.$$
For $B\in D^b_c(Z_e,A)$ and $M\in D^b_{ctf}(T_e,A)$ let $\pi_e:F_eB\otimes_A^LM\to F_e(B\otimes_A^Li_e^*M)$ and $\pi_p:F_pC_ZB\otimes_A^LC_TM\to F_p(C_ZB\otimes_A^Li_p^*C_TM)$ be the canonical ordinary-counit-defined projection transformations [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Under the monoidal comparison and $i_p^*C_T\cong C_Zi_e^*$, their precise compatibility is
$$\eta_{B\otimes_A^Li_e^*M}\circ\pi_p=C_T(\pi_e)\circ(\eta_B\otimes1_{C_TM}).$$
This equality is an equality of the named transformations, including their inverses whenever the finite-stage projection formula makes them invertible.
